neighbours.label: The word piece 'ina' when the tokenizer splits it off after an opening chunk, usually as a word's ending in names, places or nouns (mar|ina, ocar|ina, Paul|ina, Burk|ina) and also mid-word (v|ina|igrette); a few whole-word -ina names fire too (Christina, Carolina, Gina). Quiet: whole-word -ina tokens like stamina, retina, Argentina, Regina; 'Carolina' right after North/South; -ana, -ino, -ita words (banana, margarita) and 'nominal'.
